newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Ljubljana bourse to expand SBI index on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ljubljana bourse to expand SBI index on Monday.

text.p: The Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Friday it would include three more companies in the SBI index from Monday.
The new shares to be included in the index are drug company Lek's issue A, shares of food maker Droga and ordinary shares of trader Kovinotehna.
"We decided to include these companies in the index because they are among the most actively traded on the main market," Tomaz Rotar, the bourse's deputy chief executive, told Reuters.
Currently, the SBI index comprises seven issues -- banks SKB and Probanka, financial consultancies Finmedia, Dadas and Nika, food producer Kolinska and health resort Terme Catez.
A total of 24 shares are traded on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse.
The bourse said earlier this week it would introduce a completely overhauled SBI index in January next year. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
